module Fastlane
  module Actions
    module SharedValues
      DSYM_PATHS = :DSYM_PATHS
      DSYM_LATEST_UPLOADED_DATE = :DSYM_LATEST_UPLOADED_DATE
    end
    class DownloadDsymsAction < Action
      # rubocop:disable Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
      def self.run(params)
        require 'openssl'
        require 'spaceship'
        require 'net/http'
        require 'date'
        require 'json'
        require 'base64'

        default_token_duration = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token::DEFAULT_TOKEN_DURATION
        max_token_duration = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token::MAX_TOKEN_DURATION
        api_token = nil
        api_key_hash = params[:api_key]
        api_key_filepath = params[:api_key_path]
        if api_key_hash
          normalized_key = api_key_hash.transform_keys(&:to_sym)
          key_id = normalized_key[:key_id]
          issuer_id = normalized_key[:issuer_id]
          token_filepath = normalized_key[:filepath]
          key = normalized_key[:key]
          is_key_content_base64 = normalized_key[:is_key_content_base64]
          duration = normalized_key[:duration]
          in_house = normalized_key[:in_house]

          key_id ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID']
          issuer_id ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_ISSUER_ID']
          token_filepath ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_KEY_FILEPATH']
          duration ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_TOKEN_DURATION']
          duration ||= default_token_duration

          in_house_env = ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_IN_HOUSE']
          in_house ||= !["", "no", "false", "off", "0"].include?(in_house_env) if in_house_env

          key ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_KEY']
          key ||= File.binread(token_filepath) if token_filepath

          if !key.nil? && is_key_content_base64
            key = Base64.decode64(key)
          end

          api_token = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.new(
            key_id: key_id,
            issuer_id: issuer_id,
            key: OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(key),
            key_raw: key,
            duration: duration,
            in_house: in_house
          )
        elsif api_key_filepath
          json = JSON.parse(File.read(api_key_filepath), { symbolize_names: true })
          missing_keys = []
          missing_keys << 'key_id' unless json.key?(:key_id)
          missing_keys << 'issuer_id' unless json.key?(:issuer_id)
          missing_keys << 'key' unless json.key?(:key)
          if !missing_keys.empty?
            raise "App Store Connect API key JSON is missing field(s): #{missing_keys.join(', ')}"
          end

          key_id = json[:key_id]
          issuer_id = json[:issuer_id]
          token_filepath = json[:filepath]
          key = json[:key]
          is_key_content_base64 = json[:is_key_content_base64]
          duration = json[:duration]
          in_house = json[:in_house]

          key_id ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID']
          issuer_id ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_ISSUER_ID']
          token_filepath ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_KEY_FILEPATH']
          duration ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_TOKEN_DURATION']
          duration ||= default_token_duration

          in_house_env = ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_IN_HOUSE']
          in_house ||= !["", "no", "false", "off", "0"].include?(in_house_env) if in_house_env

          key ||= ENV['SPACESHIP_CONNECT_API_KEY']
          key ||= File.binread(token_filepath) if token_filepath

          if !key.nil? && is_key_content_base64
            key = Base64.decode64(key)
          end

          api_token = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.new(
            key_id: key_id,
            issuer_id: issuer_id,
            key: OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(key),
            key_raw: key,
            duration: duration,
            in_house: in_house
          )
        end

        if api_token
          UI.message("Creating authorization token for App Store Connect API")
          if api_token.duration && api_token.duration.to_i > max_token_duration
            UI.verbose("App Store Connect token duration #{api_token.duration} exceeds typical #{max_token_duration}s window")
          end
          Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token = api_token
        elsif !Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token.nil?
          UI.message("Using existing authorization token for App Store Connect API")
        else
          UI.message("Login to App Store Connect (#{params[:username]})")
          portal_team_id = ENV['FASTLANE_TEAM_ID']
          portal_team_name = ENV['FASTLANE_TEAM_NAME']
          tunes_team_id = ENV['FASTLANE_ITC_TEAM_ID']
          tunes_team_name = ENV['FASTLANE_ITC_TEAM_NAME']
          if tunes_team_id
            UI.verbose("Using FASTLANE_ITC_TEAM_ID #{tunes_team_id} for App Store Connect login")
          end
          if tunes_team_name
            UI.verbose("Using FASTLANE_ITC_TEAM_NAME #{tunes_team_name} for App Store Connect login")
          end
          if portal_team_id
            UI.verbose("FASTLANE_TEAM_ID is set to #{portal_team_id}; portal login is disabled for dSYM download")
          end
          if portal_team_name
            UI.verbose("FASTLANE_TEAM_NAME is set to #{portal_team_name}; portal login is disabled for dSYM download")
          end
          if FastlaneCore::Helper.ci?
            UI.verbose("Downloading dSYMs from a CI environment")
          end
          Spaceship::ConnectAPI.login(params[:username], use_portal: false, use_tunes: true)
          UI.message("Login successful")
        end

        app = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::App.find(params[:app_identifier])
        unless app
          UI.user_error!("Could not find app with bundle identifier '#{params[:app_identifier]}' on account #{params[:username]}")
        end

        version = params[:version]
        if params[:build_number].nil?
          build_number = nil
        else
          build_number = params[:build_number].to_s
        end
        itc_platform = params[:platform]
        output_directory = params[:output_directory]
        wait_for_dsym_processing = params[:wait_for_dsym_processing]
        wait_timeout = params[:wait_timeout]
        if params[:min_version]
          min_version = Gem::Version.new(params[:min_version])
        else
          min_version = nil
        end
        if params[:after_uploaded_date].nil?
          after_uploaded_date = nil
        else
          after_uploaded_date = DateTime.parse(params[:after_uploaded_date])
        end

        if Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::ALL.include?(itc_platform)
          platform = itc_platform
        else
          case itc_platform.to_sym
          when :appletvos, :tvos
            platform = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::TV_OS
          when :osx, :macos, :mac
            platform = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::MAC_OS
          when :ios
            platform = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::IOS
          else
            raise "Cannot find a matching platform for '#{itc_platform}' - valid values are #{Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::ALL.join(', ')}"
          end
        end

        if version == 'latest'
          UI.message("Looking for latest build...")
          latest_filter = { app: app.id }
          latest_filter["preReleaseVersion.platform"] = platform
          latest_build = Spaceship::ConnectAPI.get_builds(filter: latest_filter, sort: "-uploadedDate", includes: "preReleaseVersion,buildBundles").first
          if latest_build.nil?
            if platform
              UI.user_error!("Could not find any build for platform #{platform}")
            end
            UI.user_error!("Could not find any build")
          end
          version = latest_build.app_version
          build_number = latest_build.version
        elsif version == 'live'
          UI.message("Looking for live version...")
          live_version = app.get_live_app_store_version(platform: platform)
          if live_version.nil?
            UI.user_error!("Could not find live version for your app, please try setting 'latest' or a specific version")
          end
          version = live_version.version_string
          build_number = live_version.build.version
        end

        if output_directory
          if !output_directory.end_with?('/')
            output_directory += '/'
          end
        end

        message = []
        message << "Looking for dSYM files for '#{params[:app_identifier]}' on platform #{platform}"
        if version
          message << "v#{version}"
        end
        if build_number
          message << "(#{build_number})"
        end
        UI.message(message.join(" "))

        filter = { app: app.id }
        filter["preReleaseVersion.platform"] = platform
        if version
          filter["preReleaseVersion.version"] = version
        end
        if build_number
          filter["version"] = build_number
        end
        build_resp = Spaceship::ConnectAPI.get_builds(filter: filter, sort: "-uploadedDate", includes: "preReleaseVersion,buildBundles")

        build_resp.all_pages_each do |build|
          asc_app_version = build.app_version
          asc_build_number = build.version
          uploaded_date = DateTime.parse(build.uploaded_date)

          message = []
          message << "Found train (version): #{asc_app_version}"
          if version
            message << ", comparing to supplied version: #{version}"
          end
          UI.verbose(message.join(" "))

          if version && version != asc_app_version
            UI.verbose("Version #{version} doesn't match: #{asc_app_version}")
            next
          end

          if min_version && min_version > Gem::Version.new(asc_app_version)
            UI.verbose("Min version #{min_version} not reached: #{asc_app_version}")
            next
          end

          if after_uploaded_date && after_uploaded_date >= uploaded_date
            UI.verbose("Upload date #{after_uploaded_date} not reached: #{uploaded_date}")
            next
          end

          message = []
          message << "Found build version: #{asc_build_number}"
          if build_number
            message << ", comparing to supplied build_number: #{build_number}"
          end
          UI.verbose(message.join(" "))

          if build_number && asc_build_number != build_number
            UI.verbose("build_version: #{asc_build_number} doesn't match: #{build_number}")
            next
          end
